Vendor specific operation vector callbacks, nested interception predicates and exception queueing primitives.
Remainder of per processor virtualization enable after backward clock observation plus shutdown and per processor disable paths cut off in the fragment.

findings.text: This slice supplies run control, multiprocessor state query and update, guest debug update, address translation, floating state query and update, virtual processor creation and post creation, Xen event delivery and Xen initialization, signal mask handling and guest page cache initialization for upper virtualization layers to call.

The architecture run entry prepares translation state, loads the virtual processor, activates the alternate signal mask, clears run flags, loads guest floating state and holds the sleepable read lock for the attempt. It handles the uninitialized multiprocessor state with blocking and signal accounting, validates synchronized register masks, applies dirty registers, reconciles a userspace supplied exception with nested interception, drains a previously registered userspace input output completion, verifies wish to run, executes pre run checks then the main loop, and on exit restores floating state, writes back registers unless protected, saves post run state, releases the lock, restores signals and unloads.

The main loop begins with unknown exit status and repeats while forward progress continues. Each pass records position as away from an instruction edge, then enters the guest when runnable or blocks otherwise. Non positive outcomes end the loop. On continuation it clears the unblock request, delivers pending Xen events and pending timer activity, exits with interrupt window open when the device model asks for injection and the processor can accept interrupts, and handles transfer to guest work with the read lock briefly released. Signal related work ends the loop with its status.

Before every guest entry or block the code marks execution as no longer on an instruction edge. The visible rationale is that flush activity requested from a sibling processor while emulating one operation must not let later emulation micro steps keep using outdated mappings, so everything after the update is treated as able to start fresh execution.

Emulated memory mapped input output advances through a fragment list in eight byte increments. Reads copy from the shared run area into the current fragment while writes skip the copy. Short fragments move to the next index and longer ones advance address and remaining length in place with a guard against aliasing the embedded value. When all fragments finish the need flag clears and writes finish at once while reads mark completion and resume instruction emulation. Otherwise the next fragment is exposed to userspace and the same completion routine is armed again.

Multiprocessor state moves among runnable, halted, uninitialized, reset hold, init received and a legacy sipi received code. Creation starts runnable without kernel interrupt chip or for the reset bootstrap processor and uninitialized otherwise. The run entry blocks while uninitialized and leaves on signals. The setter accepts the enumerated codes, requires kernel interrupt chip for all but runnable, converts the legacy code to init received with a pending sipi marker for compatibility, stores the new state and raises an event request. The getter folds halted and reset hold with paravirtual unhalt into runnable. Pre run rejects the legacy code and impossible init combinations.

The pre run gate downgrades a trusted nested run marker to untrusted because userspace may have altered state, rejects obsolete and impossible multiprocessor states, rejects processors needing initialization, and diverts unhandleable emulation to a failure exit with a neutral status. Success returns a positive go ahead value.

Xen event delivery protects the guest virtual processor info mapping with an interrupt saving read lock. Validity for the expected structure size is checked under the lock. When invalid the lock is released, a refresh is attempted outside the lock, and the lock is reacquired for revalidation. Failure to refresh aborts without touching guest memory. The mapping is marked dirty before the final unlock.

If no pending selector bits are present delivery returns immediately. Otherwise the host bits are atomically merged into the guest view and cleared from the host copy with locked memory operations, then the guest upcall pending flag is set. Sixty four bit guests in long mode use wide operations on the native structure while others use narrow operations on the compatibility structure. When a per processor upcall vector is configured delivery finishes with a message signaled interrupt.
When Xen support is compiled out the event injection and processor initialization helpers exist as empty inline routines with no effects, preserving call sites while eliminating behaviour.

The sleepable read lock is held across the run attempt and across multiprocessor state queries. It is temporarily released around transfer to guest work handling and around blocking while uninitialized, then reacquired before continuing. Signal related transfer work warns unless interrupted and records a signal exit before returning its status.

The advanced interrupt virtualization inhibit state for guest debugging is updated under a write lock. The updater scans all virtual processors for the block interrupts debug flag and then sets or clears the block interrupt inhibit reason to match whether any processor requested it.

A freshly initialized guest to host cache holds an initialized read write lock and refresh mutex, a back pointer to the virtual machine, a fault sentinel for the page frame number, an invalid sentinel for the guest address, a bad sentinel for the user address, and cleared active and valid flags.

Floating state exchange mirrors the kernel save area with the userspace structure. The x87 stack image moves as a one hundred twenty eight byte block, control status tag opcode and pointer fields move pairwise, and the vector register file moves as a whole. Confidential state short circuits the exchange without touching processor state.

Address translation takes a linear address and returns a physical address with a validity flag derived from comparison against the invalid sentinel. The writeable flag is always set and the user mode flag is always cleared in this slice.

Guest debug update rejects protected guests, then handles breakpoint or debug injection only when no exception is already pending or injected, queuing the requested vector. It preserves flags across the update, stores the control word with enable gating, loads effective breakpoints from the request when hardware breakpoints are selected else from the stored set, refreshes debug control, captures the linear instruction pointer when single stepping, reapplies flags to adjust trace behaviour, refreshes the exception bitmap and reconciles the interrupt virtualization inhibit.

Pre creation checks for unstable timekeeping on multiprocessor virtual machines, establishes a default maximum processor identifier, enforces identifier bounds, invokes vendor pre creation, and lazily creates mediated performance monitoring when enabled with kernel interrupt chip, otherwise disabling performance monitoring. Creation initializes entry tracking, register availability, time caches, multiprocessor state, memory management, local interrupt controller, port input output buffer, machine check banks with capability count, writeback mask, emulation context, floating state, async fault state, feature quirks, performance monitoring, pending vector, preemption flag and hypervisor root paging, then invokes vendor creation, Xen initialization, post identifier setup, timekeeping, reset and memory initialization with reverse order unwinding on failure. Post creation synchronizes timekeeping under the processor mutex and enables poll control by default.

Directed yield considers a processor runnable when paravirtual unhalt is set, when non maskable interrupt, system management interrupt where available, or general event requests are pending, or when advanced interrupt virtualization is active and the vendor reports a pending interrupt. A separate accessor reports whether the processor was preempted while in kernel mode.

Signal mask handling acts only when a custom set is active. Activation installs the virtual processor set while saving the prior blocked set in the current task with a lockless update that relies on subset preservation. Deactivation restores the saved set and clears the saved storage.

Register synchronization validates user supplied valid and dirty masks against the allowed set and rejects out of range bits. Dirty state triggers a from user sync with special handling that consumes the events bit after applying it. The to user path always synchronizes base registers and additionally fetches events when requested. Write back on run exit occurs only when valid bits are present and guest state is not protected.

Invalid masks, failed register sync, illegal task priority updates, obsolete or disallowed multiprocessor states, initialization required states, debug injection collisions, protected state accesses and out of range processor identifiers surface as errors with no guest entry. Missing port or memory mapped completion state is treated as a host bug and fails the operation. Uninitialized processors report interruption or retry with signal exits counted. Unhandleable emulation diverts to a failure exit rather than entering the guest.

The run interface uses symbolic exit reasons for unknown entry state, interrupt window open and interrupted execution. Multiprocessor states use symbolic codes for runnable, halted, uninitialized, reset hold, init received and legacy sipi received. Register synchronization uses a symbolic flag for event state. Port and memory completion, exception vectors for debug and breakpoint, and machine check bank counts are also expressed with symbolic constants.

Most control operations load the virtual processor on entry and unload on exit, pairing sleep and reference handling. Multiprocessor queries additionally hold the sleepable read lock across event acceptance. Post creation serializes time synchronization with an interruptible processor mutex and returns early if acquisition is interrupted.

When guest state is protected, floating state queries and updates are refused or ignored based on virtual machine capability without loading the processor, guest debug updates are refused, and register write back on run exit is skipped. The translation helper always reports user context as supervisor and write access as allowed, which callers must not interpret as a full permission check.

Userspace input output completion is single shot. The run entry fetches and clears a pending completion callback before invoking it, and a non positive result ends the ioctl without entering the guest. When no callback is pending the entry warns if port counts or memory need flags are unexpectedly set. Port completion requires a non zero count and then resumes instruction emulation without decoding. Memory completion re arms itself until all fragments finish as described separately.

Virtualization enable and disable register and unregister an emergency disable callback obtained from the vendor operation vector. Per processor enable brings user return state online, verifies processor compatibility, invokes vendor enable, samples the cycle counter and walks all virtual machines and processors to request clock updates on unstable timekeeping or to observe backward time movement for later compensation.
